trajectory.development: Sequence B opening (d2 alone): the bond-keeping practices are shown working under the old regularity, before any loss. The vision records that these practices already exist and that every island has so far returned; placing them first is a proposal about order, not a recorded stage.
trajectory.becomes_available: A baseline of relationships and practices the reader can lose. It rests on the vision's statement that the practices already sustain friendships across changing seas (E5, E2).
trajectory.changes: Nothing earlier exists to change. It gives d1's later failure a human cost the reader has already felt, rather than one stated after the fact.
trajectory.quote: Families maintain friendships across changing seas.

trajectory.development: The broken pattern (d1): one inhabited island does not return when expected, breaking the one regularity the communities trusted. The disappearance itself is recorded in the vision; its placement in a Book is not.
trajectory.becomes_available: Pressure, action and revelation from every attempt to explain, exploit, mourn or reverse the failure (E1). It needs the prior regularity the vision records: every known island has so far reappeared (E5).
trajectory.changes: The practices of the first stage stop being routine and become something that might fail. The migrations, previously lived with, become something people now want explained (d3).
trajectory.quote: This year, one inhabited island does not return when expected.

trajectory.development: The bonds are tested (d1 acting on d2): markets, celebrations, shared craft and generosity are made to adapt to a loss they were never built for, producing repeated action families of reaching out, keeping faith and repairing.
trajectory.becomes_available: A renewable action pattern for the middle of the series. The Architecture's link records that the engine tests whether bond-keeping practices can survive a broken pattern (E7, E2).
trajectory.changes: The practices shown earlier are revealed as conditional: they assumed every distance was temporary. What looked like stable custom now reads as a bet that the map would come back.
trajectory.quote: The disappearance tests whether those practices can adapt, producing repeated action families of reaching out, keeping faith and repairing.

trajectory.development: Partial answers about the migrations (d3 under d1): each attempt to explain the failure produces some understanding, and each partial answer reopens what else the communities assumed was stable. The engine's renewal is recorded; the content of any answer is not stated in the cited items.
trajectory.becomes_available: An escalation that does not exhaust itself. It follows from the engine's stated renewability: partial answers reopen assumptions rather than closing the question (E1, E3).
trajectory.changes: The bonds tested earlier gain a second exposure: if other assumed regularities are also unstable, keeping faith extends beyond the one missing island to the map as a whole.
trajectory.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

trajectory.development: If the author keeps working configuration B, the question of explicability (d3) settles on partial understanding: enough is known to stop treating the map as about to be restored, not enough to make the migrations fully explicable. This is proposed; the question itself is still open in the Architecture.
trajectory.becomes_available: A release from the hope of reversal without a full solution. It needs the partial answers of the previous stage and the question's own middle option, partially understood (E3, E4).
trajectory.changes: The attempts to reverse the failure (E1) become, in retrospect, part of mourning it. The explanation stops being the series' goal and becomes the condition under which the bonds must be rebuilt.
trajectory.quote: How far should the migrations be explained by the end: fully explicable, partially understood, or enduringly mysterious?

trajectory.development: Culmination under working configuration B: the missing island is not restored, and the communities re-form their bonds across a permanently changed map. This is the exercise's configuration, which the record says are not the author's words, so it is proposed.
trajectory.becomes_available: An ending in which d2 answers what d1 broke, while d3 stays partly open. It needs bonds that have already adapted under test (E2, E7) and a settled refusal to restore the island (E4).
trajectory.changes: The earlier repairs stop being stopgaps awaiting the island's return and become the new form of the practices themselves. The whole arc reads as adaptation, not recovery.
trajectory.quote: The series closes with the communities re-forming their bonds across a permanently changed map, and the migrations' explanation left only partly understood.

relations.reason: The practices exist without d1 (the vision records them before the disappearance), so d1 is not a prerequisite of d2 itself. But d2's arc of adaptation, reaching out, keeping faith and repairing, is generated by d1's failure, so d1 is what sets d2 in motion.
relations.quote: tests whether bond-keeping practices can survive a broken pattern

relations.reason: The migrations exist and are lived with before the failure (E5), so d3's question can be asked without d1. d1 makes it pressing: every attempt to explain the failure is a step toward or away from explicability. Preparation, not prerequisite.
relations.quote: The one trusted regularity fails, and every attempt to explain, exploit, mourn or reverse that failure generates pressure, action and revelation.

relations.reason: The engine renews itself through partial answers. A fully explicable resolution of d3 would remove the source of that renewal, so the answer to d3 constrains how long d1 can keep generating pressure. Partial understanding keeps the engine's renewal intact.
relations.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

relations.reason: d2 is recorded as a layer under d1 (parent en-unreturned-island). It gives the engine's abstract responses, mourn and reverse, a social form: what people do to keep each other is what the failure threatens.
relations.quote: Communities act through practices (traveling markets, celebrations, shared craft, generosity) to keep relationships alive.

relations.reason: Whether bonds can be re-formed does not depend on how far the migrations are explained, and the explanation does not need the bonds. The working configuration states the two as separate clauses of the ending. They should stay independent so each can resolve on its own terms.
relations.quote: the communities re-forming their bonds across a permanently changed map, and the migrations' explanation left only partly understood

culmination.statement: Working configuration B (stated in the record as not the author's words): the missing island is not restored; the communities re-form their bonds across a permanently changed map; the migrations are left only partly understood. Read backward, it needs a loss that holds, practices that adapt, and a question resolved toward its middle option.

necessary.text: The island's non-return must hold to the end. The working configuration excludes restoration, so any reversal attempt raised by the engine must fail or be abandoned.
necessary.quote: the missing island is not restored.

necessary.text: The bond-keeping practices must actually adapt, not merely endure. Re-forming bonds across a changed map is the adaptation the engine was testing for.
necessary.quote: The disappearance tests whether those practices can adapt, producing repeated action families of reaching out, keeping faith and repairing.

necessary.text: The explicability question must settle on partial understanding, neither full explanation nor enduring mystery.
necessary.quote: How far should the migrations be explained by the end: fully explicable, partially understood, or enduringly mysterious?

enrichment.text: Showing the practices working before the loss (Sequence B) makes the final re-forming read as a change to something the reader knew, not to something only described.
enrichment.quote: Traveling markets, seasonal celebrations, shared craftsmanship, and acts of generosity help people sustain relationships even when familiar places become distant.

enrichment.text: Competing interpretations of the disappearance let the re-formed bonds cross a division the loss created, not only a distance.
enrichment.quote: The disappearance creates uncertainty, opportunities, competing interpretations, and consequences for people whose lives depend on the shifting geography.

enrichment.text: Partial answers that each reopen another assumption make the changed map wider than one missing island, which gives the final re-forming more to span.
enrichment.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

culmination.standalone_value: If the culmination never arrives, an earlier Book still keeps its own experience: a test of whether a particular bond survives a particular distance, resolved by a particular act of reaching out or repair. It also keeps one partial answer that changes what its people take for granted. Neither needs the final map to mean something.

alternative_paths.ordering: Sequence A: develop the migrations' explicability early (d3 pursued soon after d1's failure), and test the bonds afterward (d2 under pressure in later Books).
alternative_paths.effect: Easier: a clear investigative engine from the start, with the reader oriented by questions. Harder: the loss reads first as a puzzle, not a grief, and early answers spend the renewal that partial answers provide. It emphasises curiosity. It risks closing 'enduringly mysterious' early and leaves less room for bonds to carry the late Books.
alternative_paths.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

alternative_paths.ordering: Sequence B: establish the bonds first (d2 under the old regularity), let the island fail to return (d1) so the loss is felt, and seek the explanation (d3) after.
alternative_paths.effect: Easier: the reader shares the communities' attachment, which matches the vision's order (practices described before the disappearance). Harder: opening Books need their own pressure before the engine fires. It emphasises attachment and grief. It keeps all three answers to d3 open longer and fits configuration B's bond-centred ending.
alternative_paths.quote: Every inhabited island known to the communities has eventually reappeared within its expected migration cycle.

alternative_paths.ordering: Interleaved (proposed): after d1's failure, pair each partial answer about the migrations with a test or repair of a bond, so that understanding and adaptation advance together across the Books.
alternative_paths.effect: Keeps d2 and d3 independent while letting each beat of one sharpen the other. It risks a repetitive rhythm unless the partial answers widen what is unstable, as the engine's renewal allows. It is not stated in the cited items and would be the author's choice.
alternative_paths.quote: each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable

opportunities.text: The engine names four responses, explain, exploit, mourn, reverse, and the vision records competing interpretations. Together with d2, the bonds can be strained not only by distance but by communities choosing different responses to the same loss. Repairing those bonds is something neither development gives alone.
opportunities.quote: The disappearance creates uncertainty, opportunities, competing interpretations, and consequences for people whose lives depend on the shifting geography.

opportunities.text: Proposed: under partial understanding, the practices themselves (markets, celebrations, shared craft) could become how the communities live with what is unexplained, so d2 answers the question d3 leaves open without explaining it. This assumes the author wants the bonds, not the explanation, to carry the ending.
opportunities.quote: Communities act through practices (traveling markets, celebrations, shared craft, generosity) to keep relationships alive.

opportunities.text: All three together: if each partial answer reopens another assumed regularity, the map the bonds must span keeps changing, so the final re-forming is an adaptation to a lasting condition, not to one lost island.
opportunities.quote: The series closes with the communities re-forming their bonds across a permanently changed map

reader_experience: Sequence B lets the reader belong to the communities before the island fails, so the disappearance lands as loss and the search for explanation comes from grief. Sequence A puts the reader in an investigator's seat, so the bonds arrive as consequences of a puzzle. Under configuration B, the ending rewards attachment more than solution: the reader is left holding partly understood migrations and relationships that have changed shape but held. This reading is advisory.
open_decisions: Whether to adopt working configuration B as the author's culmination; the record states it is not the author's words.
How d3 resolves: fully explicable, partially understood, or enduringly mysterious. Configuration B assumes partial, but the Architecture question is still open.
Whether the opening Books establish bonds before the loss (Sequence B) or open on the disappearance and the investigation (Sequence A).
How many of the twelve Books the bond-testing phase occupies before partial answers begin to widen what is unstable.
uncertainty: No existing Books or Working Book elements cite these developments (coverage: zero elements read), so no stage can be placed in a specific Book.
